plugins.name: Jupyter notebook
plugins.description: Turn your guides into working notebooks. Write and run Python cells, import a notebook, and share saved results with readers.
features: Notebook editor with code, Markdown and raw cells
Run Python with a bundled interpreter and Jupyter kernel
Share saved text, errors and image outputs with readers
plugins.releaseNotes: Includes the complete notebook editor and reader, native notebook import, and managed kernel cleanup when leaving the page.

plugins.name: Three.js scenes
plugins.description: Bring an idea into three dimensions. Write Three.js code, preview a scene, and let readers explore it in your article.
features: Interactive orbit, zoom and reset controls
Saved scenes and animation clips for readers
plugins.releaseNotes: Includes the complete scene editor, code execution, saved reader views, and animation controls. Linux x86-64 requires glibc (tested on Debian bookworm); Alpine/musl is not supported.
